review_candidates.location: Abu Dhabi, Abu Dhabi Emirate, United Arab Emirates
review_candidates.description: 🤖 Senior Integration Engineer 📍 Abu Dhabi ⏳ 12-month initial contract - with extensions We are seeking an experienced Senior Integration Engineer to join a high-profile technology environment in Abu Dhabi, connecting modern digital products and automation services with complex enterprise platforms. Sitting at the intersection of application engineering and enterprise technology , you will design and build secure, reliable integrations across ERP, HR, Finance, collaboration platforms and custom applications. This is not an ETL-only or middleware administration role . We are looking for an engineer who can design and build production-grade APIs, event flows, messaging patterns and integration services while solving the challenges that come with connecting complex enterprise systems. What You'll Be Doing Design and implement robust system-to-system integrations across enterprise platforms. Build and consume REST, OData, SOAP and enterprise APIs . Develop asynchronous integrations using messaging and event-driven architectures . Design integration patterns supporting complex and long-running enterprise workflows. Define API contracts and integration standards alongside application and platform engineering teams. Build transformations between different enterprise data models and establish canonical schemas where appropriate. Engineer resilient integrations using retries, timeout handling, idempotency, reconciliation and dead-letter processing . Design solutions capable of safely handling partial failures and unavailable downstream systems. Implement OAuth2, service identities, certificates and enterprise authentication/authorisation patterns . Apply API versioning, lifecycle management and API gateway standards. Maintain auditability, traceability and appropriate handling of sensitive information across system boundaries. Build logging, monitoring and alerting to ensure integrations are observable and supportable in production. Troubleshoot complex production issues spanning multiple enterprise systems. Support integration testing, UAT, deployment and production rollout. What We're Looking For You will have 6+ years of experience in enterprise integration or backend engineering , with strong hands-on experience designing and implementing APIs and integration services. You should bring strong knowledge of REST, JSON and HTTP , alongside experience working with SOAP/XML and legacy enterprise integrations . You'll also understand asynchronous messaging and event-driven architecture, including practical experience with error handling, retry strategies, idempotency and production reliability. Hands-on development experience with Java, C#, Python, Go or a comparable backend language is required, alongside experience supporting enterprise integrations in production. Highly Desirable Experience SAP integration – OData, BAPIs, IDocs, RFC and APIs SAP BTP Integration Suite / Cloud Integration Azure Integration Services Azure Service Bus / Event Grid Azure API Management Apache Kafka SAP SuccessFactors integrations SAP Ariba integrations Microsoft Graph / SharePoint Government, financial services or other regulated enterprise environments please apply to be contacted with further information.
